Cliffside Hotel Overlooking Ardmore Bay, Co. Waterford
Five-Star Luxury Hotel in Ardmore, County Waterford
Cliff House Hotel is a 5-star, privately owned luxury hotel on Ireland's southern coast, located close to both Cork and Waterford.
Perched dramatically on the cliffs above the historic fishing village of Ardmore, our privately owned, 39-room seaside hotel combines contemporary Irish design with panoramic Atlantic Ocean views, MICHELIN-starred dining at HOUSE Restaurant and restorative wellness at The Well by the Sea spa .
Named among the Irish Independent Hot 100 Hotels 2026, Cliff House Hotel is also a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World and the exceptional collection of Ireland’s Blue Book, making it one of Ireland’s most distinctive luxury coastal hotels.
Bestow the perfect gift of luxury with a Cliff House hotel voucher . Choose from monetary or curated packages tailored to suit all special gifting occasions.
Five-Star Seaside Luxury in Ireland
From sun-drenched terraces and private balconies, it is possible to see Ardmore’s golden sands, lobster pots and dolphins that play out on the water. All our luxury hotel rooms and suites are sea-facing while many are interconnected to provide family-friendly configurations.
From this dramatic coastal location in Ireland’s gourmet heartland, it is possible to enjoy some of the country’s best restaurants—including our own Michelin-starred House Restaurant . As well as House , we also offer the more casual Oceanfront Restaurant & bar and summer terrace dining.
Explore Accommodation Options
Rooted in Heritage
Cliff House Hotel is rooted in the history and landscape of Ardmore, one of Ireland’s oldest Christian settlements. Just moments from the hotel, centuries of heritage can be discovered through Ardmore’s 12th-century Round Tower, cathedral ruins and St Declan’s Well. That strong sense of place continues throughout the hotel, where contemporary Irish design, local craftsmanship and spectacular views across Ardmore Bay connect every stay to the culture, coast and character of County Waterford.
Our distinctly Irish, contemporary design draws inspiration from the landscape itself, with white walls, local stone, sedum-covered roofs and limestone terraces that settle naturally into the cliffside. Inside, one of Ireland’s largest collections of campaign furniture sits alongside specially commissioned Irish craftsmanship, from hand-loomed wall pieces by Muriel Beckett to bespoke carpets featuring Celtic motifs - bringing together heritage, craft and modern Irish design.
At the heart of it all is a tradition of warm Irish hospitality, thoughtfully carried forward for a new generation of guests.
Dining by the Sea
From MICHELIN-starred dining at HOUSE Restaurant to relaxed dishes and drinks in Oceanfront overlooking Ardmore Bay, food is at the heart of the Cliff House experience. Led by Executive Head Chef Dan Crewe, our menus celebrate the finest Irish produce, shaped by the seasons and our coastal setting.
Come for the food, stay for the view.
Explore Dining
Wellness by the Sea
Perched above Ardmore Bay, The Well by the Sea is Cliff House Hotel’s luxury destination spa in Waterford, created for rest and relaxation on Ireland’s south coast. Unwind with restorative spa treatments, swim in the indoor infinity pool overlooking the sea, or relax in the outdoor heated Jacuzzi as you take in the coastal views. A peaceful retreat for a spa break, romantic escape or simply time to slow down in Ardmore.
Discover The Well by the Sea
Discover Ardmore & Ireland s South Coast
Step outside Cliff House Hotel and discover one of Ireland’s most captivating coastal villages. Walk the 4km Ardmore Cliff Walk from close to the hotel, explore Ardmore’s 12th-century Round Tower and cathedral ruins, stroll along Ardmore Beach or take to the water for sea swimming, kayaking and paddleboarding.
Further afield, discover the Waterford Greenway, the Comeragh and Knockmealdown Mountains, historic Lismore and the coastal towns and countryside of West Waterford and East Cork.

5-Star Hotel Rooms Waterford
Accommodation
Overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, our five-star accommodation combines
contemporary comfort with spectacular coastal views, offering guests an exceptional seaside stay on Ireland’s Copper Coast. Cliff House Hotel offers a collection of sea view hotel accommodation & self-catering residences in the charming village of Ardmore. Hotel guests can choose from design-led contemporary rooms and suites, all featuring uninterrupted ocean views.
Sea View Rooms & Suites
Peruse our range of elegantly furnished oceanfront rooms.
Discover more
Cliff Residences
Explore our premium selection of private rentals located in Ardmore and Ballyduff, Co. Waterford.
Discover more
Design Inspiration
Our 5-star hotel rooms in Waterford are uniquely positioned along the cliff’s edge, where floor-to-ceiling glass draws the Atlantic into your space, creating a constant connection to nature. Each room and suite at Cliff House Hotel is designed to highlight the dramatic beauty of Ardmore Bay.
Designed with a refined, contemporary aesthetic, our hotel rooms combine natural textiles, bespoke artwork, clean lines, soft textures and calming tones that echo the land and seascape beyond. Most rooms feature private balconies, and suites open onto outdoor terraces, inviting guests to step outside in the ocean air.
More than just a place to rest, each room is designed to instil a sense of calm and quiet indulgence, where time slows and every moment is shaped by the rhythm of the sea.
Room Types
Our accommodation collection includes stylish Deluxe Sea View rooms, spacious Terrace Suites and distinctive Veranda Suites overlooking the ocean. Guests wake to the sound of the
sea, enjoy uninterrupted coastal views and relax in beautifully appointed surroundings that combine contemporary design with the warmth and comfort of a five-star stay.
View all Room Types
What our Guests say:
"It s the view that lingers longest, expansive, uninterrupted and endlessly soothing."
FAQs
Frequently Asked Questions
Do all rooms at Cliff House Hotel have sea views?
Yes, all hotel rooms have sea views in are designed to maximise the coastal setting, with most offering balconies and terraces facing the Atlantic. Our sea view rooms in Ardmore are positioned along the cliff, allowing guests to enjoy the changing light and seascape throughout their stay.
What amenities are included in each bedroom?
At Cliff House Hotel , bedrooms are thoughtfully appointed to combine comfort with understated luxury. Guests can expect:
King-size beds with premium linens
Floor-to-ceiling windows or large picture windows
Private balconies or terraces in the majority of room categories
Spacious bathrooms with rainfall showers and/or deep soaking baths
Luxury natural Irish toiletries
Bathrobes and slippers
Complimentary Wi-Fi
Flat-screen TV with entertainment options
In-room safe
Tea and coffee making facilities, including Nespresso machine
Minibar with curated selections
Climate control for personalised comfort
Each detail is designed to create a calm, restful environment where guests can fully unwind beside the sea.
Which rooms offer the best views of Ardmore Bay?
All rooms offer expansive sea views with upgrade room types providing additional space and outdoor balconies. Suites provide large terraces with uninterrupted panoramas across Ardmore bay.
What is the difference between a Deluxe Sea View room and a Balcony Suite?
A Deluxe Sea View room offers elegant comfort with uninterrupted ocean views, while a Balcony suite with sea view provides additional space and a private outdoor area. The Balcony Suite also includes enhanced living space, making it ideal for guests seeking a more elevated experience.
What is the best room type for couples staying at Cliff House Hotel?
All rooms are designed for minimum double occupancy and have views across Ardmore Bay. For extra space or a special occasion, the best room for couples in Ardmore is typically a Balcony Suite or one of the luxury suites. These offer additional space, privacy and outdoor areas, enhancing the overall experience for two.
Are Cliff House Hotel rooms suitable for romantic getaways?
Yes, Cliff House Hotel in Ardmore is well suited for couples seeking a romantic coastal escape. It is a popular choice for a couples getaway on the Waterford coast, with 5 star rooms and suites, all with sea views.
Are Cliff House Hotel rooms suitable for longer stays?
Yes, the hotel offers luxury accommodation on the Waterford coast that is well suited to extended stays. In addition the hotel offers two close by self-catering residences, Cliff Beach House and Cliff cottage. Here, guests choosing an extended stay experience can enjoy spacious accommodation, all the comforts of home and access to all facilities.
Are Cliff Residences located at the hotel?
Cliff Residences Ardmore are located within a short walk to the hotel, offering a more private setting while remaining within easy reach of all amenities. Location & Attractions in Ardmore, County Waterford
Located on Ireland s Edge
Situated on Waterford's Copper Coast and in Ireland's Ancient East, our five-star hotel is uniquely located where the counties of Cork and Waterford meet. One hour’s drive from both Cork and Waterford airports, and a two hour drive from Rosslare Car Ferry, the hotel rests high above the charming village of Ardmore overlooking the beautiful bay and the Atlantic Ocean beyond.
The coastal towns of Dungarvan and Youghal are both just 15 minute drive from the hotel. Dungarvan is home of Waterford Greenway , a 46 km track suitable for both walking and cycling. Should you wish to tour a little further, the towns of Cobh, Kinsale and Cork City are just a drive away, though everything you require for both relaxation and adventure can also be found right here in Ardmore.
Find Us - Getting to Ardmore
Discover Ardmore
Destination Cliff
Sharing the highlights of West Waterford and East Cork region is part of our commitment to your time at Cliff House and your holiday in Ireland. With expert concierge services, and genuine pride for this part our part of Ireland, we can direct you towards activities suitable in sun or rain, for the culturally curious and the actively enclined.
This includes exploring Ardmore with its sandy beach, traditional music and charming cottages. Nearby Dungarvan is a thriving seaside market town, and pretty Lismore, dominated by its castle, is possibly one of the country’s most quaint villages.
For any activities you would like to arrange in advance of your stay with us, please feel free to call our concierge on +353 24 87800 or email info@cliffhousehotel.ie.
Learn More about Ardmore
Sport And Outdoor Activities
As a luxury seaside hotel in Ireland, we make the most of our coastal location by encouraging guests to engage with the great outdoors and the various leisure activities nearby, whether it’s fishing the Blackwater or exploring Ardmore’s famous Round Tower. We also have tee-times available for those seeking a golfing holiday.
In addition, our destination spa in Waterford, Ireland, offers a full range of outdoor wellness activities, including sea kayaking and surfing.
Learn More
Family Stays and Activities For Children
As a luxury family hotel in Ireland, we make it our business to provide activities for children of all ages. Both summer and winter, the region between Cork and Waterford offers great variety, including wet weather attractions in Ireland and activities suitable for smaller members of the family.
Learn More
A Waterford Hotel Tied To Irish Culture
As a luxury hotel in Waterford, Ireland, Cliff House Hotel is well placed to access a number of cultural events and destinations for all ages and interests. This includes good proximity to historical Cork City.
The region is rich in tradition. We are located close to Ring – a Gaeltacht or Irish-speaking area – while the nearby Blackwater Valley sequesters some 70 historic ‘Big Houses’ on its wooded banks. Ardmore itself has its own rich history as one of Ireland’s oldest Christian fishing settlements.
Lismore Heritage Centre is approximately a 30-minute drive from Cliff House Hotel, steeped in history. Immerse yourself in a 360 degree virtual reality experience of the rooms inside Lismore Castle.
Ireland s Gastronomic Edge
The area of West Waterford is a gourmet cornucopia – recently dubbed ‘the hottest place to eat in Ireland’ by a prominent national magazine. Cliff House Hotel has contributed to that reputation, with our HOUSE Restaurant holding a Michelin Star since 2009.
From Lismore’s Michael McGrath, who is possibly the best butcher in all of Ireland, to the traditional blaas that come from Barron’s Bakery & Coffee House in Cappoquin, this is a region defined by exceptional seafood, artisan producers and a commitment to eating well.
Learn More
Shopping South East Ireland s Boutiques
Both Waterford City and Cork City are an hour’s drive from Cliff House Hotel. These two shopping capitals have numerous boutiques featuring Irish products, from handcrafted homewares to jewellery.
Cork City is also where you will find Brown Thomas for fashion, and the impeccably put together Meadows & Byrne for home furnishings (also featured at Blarney Mills ).
There are a number of independent boutiques close to our hotel.
Learn More
Frequently Ask Questions
Is Cliff House Hotel close to Cork City and Waterford City?
Yes, both Cork City and Waterford City are approximately one hour from Cliff House Hotel, making it an ideal base for exploring the South East of Ireland.
What cultural attractions can I visit during my stay?
Nearby cultural attractions include Reginald's Tower , Waterford Treasures Museums , the Jameson Distillery Midleton , and immersive experiences at Lismore Castle .
Are there family-friendly activities nearby?
Yes, the area offers plenty of family-friendly activities including beach days, kayaking with Urchin Adventures, visits to Fota Wildlife Park , Ardmore Open Farm, and indoor entertainment centres for wet weather days.

Frequently Ask Questions
What seasonal breaks are available at Cliff House Hotel?
Cliff House Hotel offers seasonal breaks throughout the year, from summer stays by the sea and autumn escapes to cosy winter breaks and festive stays in Ardmore. Packages and experiences vary by season, allowing you to experience the Waterford coast at different times of the year. To view our seasonal breaks, click below.
View Seasonal Packages
Can I book a special occasion stay at Cliff House Hotel?
Yes. Cliff House Hotel is an ideal setting for birthdays, anniversaries, romantic breaks and other special occasions. Our team can help you plan a stay with dining, spa experiences and thoughtful touches to make your visit memorable. Just contact us with your requirements and we'll be delighted to suggest the best options for your special occasion.
Is Cliff House Hotel suitable for a romantic break in Ireland?
Yes. Overlooking Ardmore Bay on Ireland’s south coast, Cliff House Hotel is particularly suited to romantic getaways, with sea-view rooms and suites, Michelin-starred dining at HOUSE Restaurant, spa experiences and coastal walks nearby. Our Couples Retreat Package is particluarly popular, see below for details.
Couples Retreat Package
What can I do during a stay in Ardmore?
There is plenty to experience in and around Ardmore, including the Ardmore Cliff Walk, beaches, historic sites and the village itself. Cliff House Hotel is also well positioned for exploring West Waterford and attractions including the Waterford Greenway.
Discover Ardmore & Beyond
Is Cliff House Hotel a good choice for an autumn or winter break?
Yes. Ardmore has a very different character outside the summer months, making autumn and winter ideal for a quieter coastal escape. Guests can combine walks and time by the sea with spa treatments, relaxed dining and time overlooking Ardmore Bay.
Does Cliff House Hotel offer Christmas and New Year breaks?
Cliff House Hotel offers seasonal experiences during the festive period, including pre and post Christmas stays, New Year stays and festive dining experiences. Availability and packages vary each year, so early booking is recommended.
Contact us to learn more
Can I combine my stay with a spa treatment?
Yes. Guests can add time at Well by the Sea, Cliff House Hotel’s spa, to their stay. The spa offers a range of treatments and wellness experiences, making it particularly suited to relaxing, romantic and restorative breaks.
How far is Cliff House Hotel from Cork and Waterford?
Cliff House Hotel is located in Ardmore, County Waterford, on Ireland’s south coast. It is approximately one hour from Cork City and one hour from Waterford City , making it well suited to a short coastal break from either city.
What is the best time of year to visit Ardmore?
Ardmore is a year-round destination. Summer is ideal for longer days, beaches and outdoor activities, while autumn and winter offer quieter coastal walks, cycles, spa days and cosy hotel stays. Spring brings longer days and is an excellent time for exploring the coast and countryside.
